_about: The sector outlines of liberation-war-1971, traced by the editor (Claude) on 2026-09-28 from the sector map in NCTB «বাংলাদেশ ও বিশ্বপরিচয়», অষ্টম শ্রেণি, 2026 edition, p. ২৬ («মুক্তিযুদ্ধকালীন সেক্টরের মানচিত্র»). The scan itself stays out of git (copyright); this file holds only what was read off it — control points, the sector lines and the label positions, in the scan's own pixels — and tools/build-liberation-sectors.mjs turns it into data-sources/liberation-war-1971/sectors.geojson. Pixel coordinates are continuous, origin at the image's top-left corner, x right, y down.

scan.image: the page's one embedded raster, 351×429 px, taken with pdfimages

controlPoints.what: Bangladesh's northernmost point (Panchagarh): COD-AB admin0's highest-latitude vertex
the tip of the Lalmonirhat (Patgram) panhandle: COD-AB Lalmonirhat's highest-latitude vertex
Kurigram's northern tip: COD-AB Kurigram's highest-latitude vertex
the north-west's western tip (Thakurgaon): COD-AB admin0's westernmost vertex within 87.9–88.6°E, 25.5–26.3°N
the corner where the border with Assam turns into the border with Meghalaya, east of Rowmari (COD-AB admin0 vertex)
Sylhet's eastern tip: COD-AB admin0's easternmost vertex north of 24.3°N
Khagrachhari's northern tip: COD-AB Khagrachhari's highest-latitude vertex
the southern tip of the Belonia bulge (the Indian salient into Feni): COD-AB admin0's lowest-latitude vertex near the bulge
the northern bend of the Myanmar border above the Naf (Bandarban): COD-AB admin0's highest-latitude vertex there

_islands: COD-AB islands belong to the sector their district belongs to. The NCTB text (B8 p. ২৬) gives sector 1 «চট্টগ্রাম, পার্বত্য চট্টগ্রাম, কক্সবাজার ও নোয়াখালী জেলার মুহুরী নদীর পূর্বাংশ», sector 2 «নোয়াখালী জেলার অংশবিশেষ» (west of the Muhuri), sector 9 «সমগ্র বরিশাল ও পটুয়াখালী অঞ্চল, দৌলতপুর-সাতক্ষীরা সড়ক থেকে খুলনার দক্ষিণাঞ্চল»; Bhola was then part of Barisal district — the ministry's Mostafa Kamal page places Daulatkhan (Bhola) as «বরিশালের দৌলতখান থানার». The Dahagram–Angarpota exclave is Lalmonirhat's (Patgram), then Rangpur district: sector 6 («… সমগ্র রংপুর»).
_reassign: Whole COD-AB districts given to one sector whatever the traced lines cut, by the user’s decision. Bhola → 9 (2026-09-28): the book’s text gives sector 9 «সমগ্র বরিশাল ও পটুয়াখালী অঞ্চল», and Bhola was part of Barisal district in 1971; the book’s small map draws the estuary line through it.
